# Oxford English Dictionary

> The Oxford English Dictionary is a comprehensive reference of 500,000+ words documenting the history, etymology, and usage of English across British, American, and global varieties.

The OED provides detailed dictionary entries with etymologies, pronunciation guides, historical usage examples, and word frequency analysis. It includes the Historical Thesaurus for exploring synonyms and semantic relationships across the English language's development.

## Key Topics

- Etymology
- Historical usage
- Pronunciation
- Word definition
- British English
- U.S. English
- Historical Thesaurus
- Dictionary entry
- Word frequency
- Word history
- Oxford English Dictionary
- English language
- Frequency analysis
- Advanced Search

## Core Resources

- [About the OED](https://www.oed.com/information/about-the-oed): Overview of Oxford English Dictionary's 500,000+ words and language data
- [Historical Thesaurus - Start page](https://www.oed.com/thesaurus/start): Historical Thesaurus of the OED for synonym exploration and word categories

## Learning & Guides

- [Understanding entries](https://www.oed.com/information/understanding-entries): Guide to OED entry glossaries, abbreviations, pronunciation, and symbols

## Account & Settings

- [Personal account](https://www.oed.com/information/get-help-with-access/individual-account): Account management for display settings, saved searches, and subscriptions

- [jelly, adj.](https://www.oed.com/dictionary/jelly_adj2): Dictionary entry for jelly adjective with Jell-O product and usage history
